name: business_events
description: Key business events (src/observability/events.ts), by event name and whether they came from the e2e suite. One counter for every event: the dashboard and the zero-purchases alert filter it by event.
filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" OR resource.type="cloud_run_job") AND jsonPayload.schemaVersion>=1 AND jsonPayload.event:*

labels.description: The event name, such as order.completed.
"true" for the e2e suite's carts, "false" otherwise.
